description:
The TailwindTraders project has a disjointed backlog. Several work items exist but lack hierarchy and traceability.

Your goal is to organize these items into a proper structure:

1. Create a new Feature work item titled 'Product Inventory Management'.
2. Find the two existing User Stories ('Implement product inventory search' and 'Design REST API rate limiting') and link them as Children of your new Feature.
3. Link the existing Bugs to their related User Stories using the 'Related' link type:
   - 'Product price calculation bug' -> Related to 'Implement product inventory search'
   - 'Inventory count goes negative' -> Related to 'Implement product inventory search'
   - 'API 500 error on special chars' -> Related to 'Design REST API rate limiting'
4. Break down the 'Implement product inventory search' story by adding two Child Tasks:
   - Task 1: Title 'Set up Elasticsearch index for products', Remaining Work: 8
   - Task 2: Title 'Build search API endpoint', Remaining Work: 12

Starting URL: http://localhost/DefaultCollection/TailwindTraders/_boards/board/t

new_tasks.title: Set up Elasticsearch index for products
